svg.title: Figure 3-11. FMEDA SG-009 metrics per goal (estimate)
svg.desc: FMEDA FMD rev 0.10 (BL-002, draft) for SG-07, with 13 of 14 failure rates generic estimates. Metrics per goal: SG-07 B: SPFM 78.09 %, LFM 97.60 %, λSPF+λRF 63.1 FIT (ASIL B missed). Below: failure-rate split per component and failure mode, and the safety mechanisms with the failure modes they are credited on.
svg.text: Figure 3-11 · FMEDA SG-009 — metrics per goal: SG-07
FMD rev 0.10 · BL-002 · draft · FMEDA — SG-009 stock AEB availability (relay and forwarding path), generic failure rates
ESTIMATE · DRAFT — 13 of 14 failure rates are generic estimates and 0 are converted to the mission profile. The metrics below are not verified and are not evidence that a target is met.
HARDWARE ARCHITECTURAL METRICS PER SAFETY GOAL (WP-H-04 §4; rating-tables §6.3)

Dashed ticks: ASIL targets of the goals in the row (B shown alongside C for SG-01, DQ-063). λSPF + λRF is the single-point and residual part of PMHF only; the dual-point term is not computed (rating-tables §6.3).
